quotes.name: Vinnie Keane
quotes.quote: I've seen Pablo Almanzar bring a lot of energy to the team, and I feel like his journey has been really inspiring to watch. He's got a lot of heart and it shows in the way he plays.

quotes.name: Ernesto Quintero
quotes.quote: I've seen Pablo Almanzar's journey have a positive impact on the team, it's been a good vibe around the neighborhood and the stadium.

quotes.name: Melton Neilon
quotes.quote: I've seen how the team's energy shifts when someone's on a hot streak, and from what I've heard, Pablo Almanzar's journey has been a big part of that lately. As a baker, I know how one person's effort can affect the whole batch, and it sounds like he's been making a real impact.

claim: I've seen Pablo Almanzar bring a lot of energy to the team, and I feel like his journey has been really inspiring to watch. He's got a lot of heart and it shows in the way he plays.
